# CodeToolPicker

> CodeToolPicker (https://codetoolpicker.com/) is an independent comparison site and 60-second quiz that helps developers and vibe coders choose an AI coding tool. It compares Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf), Lovable, and Bolt.new on pricing, form factor, models, and best-fit use cases. Pricing checked between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-02; each page shows its own check date.

## Key pages
- [Home: quiz + comparison table](https://codetoolpicker.com/): personalized pick plus runner-up, side-by-side table, FAQ
- [AI coding tool pricing (all 41 plans, 9 tools)](https://codetoolpicker.com/ai-coding-tool-pricing/): every plan with monthly and annual prices, which plan you actually need, what a team of 5 pays, team admin/SSO controls, what costs extra, best free tools, and a dated pricing change log (plan tables verified 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-22; Devin Teams pricing and admin re-checked 2026-11-13)
- [Cursor's new bundle: should you switch to Claude Code or Copilot?](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-bundle-alternatives/): sourced comparison of Cursor's X Subscription tiers vs Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex and Google Antigravity, and who should switch (re-verified 2026-10-20)
- [Cursor vs GitHub Copilot](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-vs-copilot/): plan-by-plan pricing, models, teams, and who should pick which (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Switch from GitHub Copilot to Cursor without losing your setup](https://codetoolpicker.com/switch-from-copilot-to-cursor/): import VS Code settings, move copilot-instructions.md to AGENTS.md or .cursor/rules, port MCP servers
- [Lovable vs Bolt.new](https://codetoolpicker.com/lovable-vs-bolt/): app builders compared on pricing, credits vs tokens, teams, and GitHub sync (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Devin vs Windsurf](https://codetoolpicker.com/devin-vs-windsurf/): Cognition acquired Windsurf on July 14, 2025 and renamed the IDE to Devin Desktop on June 2, 2026; windsurf.com redirects to devin.ai/desktop. One self-serve price list (checked 2026-11-13): Free $0, Pro $20, Max $200, Teams $80/month minimum + $40 per full seat, up to 100 members (5 full seats = $200; flex seats free). Devin Cloud is included on self-serve Pro/Max/Teams and shares the quota; it can still be a separate SKU on legacy Enterprise. Nov 12 Teams update: SAML/OIDC SSO, 3-tier cost controls, BAA, 2 concurrent Free-mode SWE-2 cloud sessions. SWE-2 "permanently free" on paid Desktop/CLI is claimed in the Nov 12 blog; models docs (tables dated Nov 9) still say free through Nov 30, 2026.
- [Cursor vs Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-vs-windsurf/): AI IDEs compared on plans, included models, agents, and team pricing (verified 2026-10-19; Teams cap and $80-minimum note updated 2026-11-13)
- [Claude Code vs Cursor](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-vs-cursor/): terminal agent vs AI IDE, Claude model pricing, usage limits, teams (verified 2026-10-19)
- [Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-vs-codex/): Anthropic vs OpenAI coding agents; identical $20 / $100 / team-seat prices, Codex Free and Go tiers, five-hour limits, models, API-key mode, teams of 5, and 30 days of incident data from status.openai.com and status.claude.com (verified 2026-10-20)
- [OpenAI Codex vs Cursor](https://codetoolpicker.com/codex-vs-cursor/): ChatGPT Plus $20 includes GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex; Cursor Plus $8 is Grok-only and Cursor lists no GPT-6 models (newest OpenAI model there: GPT-5.6 Sol at $4/$20 per million tokens vs GPT-6.1 Sol $2/$10 on the API); the Codex extension officially runs inside Cursor ($28 for both); teams of 5 ($100-$125 ChatGPT Business vs $150 + usage Cursor Teams); estimated cost per agent task by route (verified 2026-10-26)
- [Codex usage limits explained (Nov 2026)](https://codetoolpicker.com/codex-usage-limits/): Codex did not go unlimited (the Nov 11-12 "unlimited tomorrow" post had no OpenAI source); on Nov 12, 2026 Codex lead Tibo Sottiaux said a banked reset was activated and rolling out; banked resets are redeemed manually (Settings > Usage & billing or /usage > Redeem reset) once a covered allowance is below 80%, restore 5-hour and weekly on Plus/Business Standard, weekly on Pro, monthly on Go, and restart the period; Plus has 5-hour plus weekly limits (estimated 15-160 GPT-6.1 Sol local messages per 5 hours), Pro has weekly only (10x/20x/50x Plus per Tibo, Nov 8); starting in December ChatGPT and Codex share one token-based allowance on Plus, Pro and Business (Instant chat excluded; exact date not published); dots' Nov 18 date applies to Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare billing, not confirmed for Pro (verified 2026-11-13)
- [Did Claude Code save your password? settings.local.json check](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-secrets-check/): "Yes, and don't ask again" saves the approved command, secrets included, as an allow rule in .claude/settings.local.json; Claude Code only adds it to your global git excludes, so it gets committed on new machines and pre-tracked repos; Apiiro found 1,122 public copies with secrets; free in-browser checker, git commands, rotate-first steps (verified 2026-11-12)
- [Claude Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5 in Claude Code](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-fable-5-2-vs-opus-5-5/): Fable 5.2 (Nov 9, 2026) costs $8/$40 per million input/output vs Opus 5.5 $4/$20 (cache reads $0.20 on both); Claude Pro and Team standard seats get Fable included until Nov 16, 2026 11:59 PM PT (up to 50% of weekly limits plus one reset), then usage credits only; Max, Ultra and Team premium include it up to 50% of weekly limits plus 1 to 3 resets expiring Mar 8, 2027; needs Claude Code 2.1.321+, /model fable; best alias now means opus; switching mid-session loses the cache; Copilot Pro+ $39 and up and Cursor bill it at list price (verified 2026-11-11)
- [JetBrains Air: which AI subscription should you bring?](https://codetoolpicker.com/jetbrains-air-subscriptions/): GitHub Copilot runs in JetBrains Air on your Copilot plan since Nov 3, 2026 (local tasks; cloud tasks via Air Teams for business customers); which subscriptions work (Copilot yes, ChatGPT for Codex yes, Claude plans only in the terminal tab, Cursor paid plans yes, API keys, JetBrains AI, free Junie Lite); Copilot Pro $10 = about $15 of usage vs JetBrains AI Pro $10 = $10; Copilot plugin vs Air; Air can't show or cap Copilot usage (verified 2026-11-10)
- [Cursor Live Apps vs Lovable vs Bolt: who should switch](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-live-apps-vs-lovable-bolt/): Cursor Live Apps (Nov 5, 2026) lets a cloud agent build a web app, add Postgres, put it behind Cursor sign-in, host it and publish to a URL after security checks; cloud agents only, so Premium $30+ (not Free or Plus $8); deploys new Cursor Origin or existing GitHub repos; public sharing on individual plans, off by default on Teams; hosting limits/prices and custom domains not published; vs Lovable Pro $25 ($250/yr) and Bolt Pro $25 ($18/mo annual), team of 5: Cursor Teams $150 + usage, Lovable Business $50 flat, Bolt Teams $150 (verified 2026-11-09)
- [SWE-2 Flash vs SWE-2](https://codetoolpicker.com/swe-2-flash-vs-swe-2/): when Cognition's faster, cheaper model is enough (Desktop and CLI only, not Devin Cloud); free until Dec 4, 2026 18:00 UTC then $0.10/M input, $0.01/M cache reads, $0.125/M cache writes, $0.50/M output; SWE-2 free on self-serve Desktop/CLI through Nov 30, 2026 then $3/$15/$0.30 cache input; Medium on Free, High and Max need a paid plan; medium-task estimate about $0.04 vs about $1.23; blog's 3x speed is a simulated 200 vs 60 tok/s replay and the one-fifth price claim does not match self-serve list rates (one-thirtieth) (verified 2026-11-06)
- [GPT in Cursor after Nov 12, 2026: what stops working and how to keep OpenAI models](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-openai-cutoff/): OpenAI's proposed Nov 12, 2026 shutoff of OpenAI models in Cursor (announced Aug 28 after SpaceX bought Cursor; not confirmed, Cursor may end sooner); Tab unaffected; Agent, Chat, Auto, Cloud Agents, Automations, CLI, API and SDK lose Cursor-supplied GPT; own OpenAI key or Azure/Bedrock gateway only covers local Chat and Agent and needs Premium $30+ or a legacy plan (Plus allows no own keys); Codex IDE extension inside Cursor works on a ChatGPT plan (Plus $20 includes GPT-6.1 Sol); cost per task by route (verified 2026-11-05)
- [Claude Max vs Ultra, and every $100 vs $200 AI coding plan](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-max-vs-ultra/): Claude Ultra ($200, was Max 20x) vs Max ($100): 10x vs 5x Pro weekly usage, no five-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, $200 vs $100 monthly API credits that don't work in Claude Code; which limit you hit decides the plan; what going from $100 to $200 buys in Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Copilot and Devin (verified 2026-11-04)
- [Jules is shutting down: best Jules alternatives](https://codetoolpicker.com/jules-alternatives/): Google Jules sessions end Nov 11, 2026 (read-only after, shut down Dec 31); how to export; Antigravity has no Google-hosted cloud runs yet and no separate task pool; hosted background agents compared (Copilot Pro $10, Codex Plus $20, Claude Code Pro $20, Cursor Premium $30, Devin Pro $20) and how to move a Jules setup
- [ChatGPT Pro Codex limits: the cut is off](https://codetoolpicker.com/chatgpt-pro-codex-limits/): what OpenAI changed on Oct 29, 2026 (Pro 200 cut canceled, Pro 100 and Pro 500 doubled), why 20x to 10x was never official, API credits by plan, and what to do now
- [What one AI coding task really costs](https://codetoolpicker.com/ai-coding-cost-per-task/): measured cost per hard task at API prices from Artificial Analysis's Coding Agent Index (checked 2026-10-29): Claude Code with Opus 5.5 $11.42 (14.5M tokens), Sonnet 5.5 $13.30 (24.1M), Antigravity CLI with Gemini 4 Argon $11.73, Codex with GPT-6 Astra $7.04 and GPT-6.1 Sol $1.50; compared with our everyday estimate ($0.69 medium Sonnet 5.5 task)
- [Claude Code alternatives](https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-alternatives/): every tool that still gives you Claude, checked 2026-10-28 (GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, Kilo Code, OpenCode, Aider, Warp, Zed, Augment Code, Amp, Devin Desktop) plus OpenAI Codex without Claude; price, Claude models included, what you lose vs Claude Code, skip-it-if notes, cheapest ways to keep Claude with estimated medium tasks per plan, tools that reuse your Claude plan limits, and teams of 5
- [Free AI coding tools](https://codetoolpicker.com/free-ai-coding-tools/): every free plan side by side (Copilot Free, Antigravity Free, Codex Free, Cursor Free, Devin Desktop Free, Kiro Free, Cline free models, Gemini CLI on a free API key, Lovable Free, Bolt Free), the catch on each, who trains on free-tier code, the cheapest upgrade for each, student plans, and the Nov 18, 2026 removal of Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6 from Antigravity (verified 2026-10-27)
- [GitHub Copilot vs Claude Code](https://codetoolpicker.com/copilot-vs-claude-code/): Copilot Pro $10 (1,500 AI credits, includes Claude Sonnet 5.5; Opus 5.5 needs Pro+ $39; unlimited completions) vs Claude Pro $20 (five-hour limits); free tiers, Copilot's Claude cloud agent, teams of 5 ($95 vs $100-$125), who should pick which (verified 2026-10-21)
- [Cursor vs Google Antigravity](https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-vs-antigravity/): Google AI Pro $19.99 includes Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 vs Cursor Premium $30 + API-priced Claude; free tiers, limits, surfaces, teams of 5, and what switching actually costs (overlap month, leftover credit, legacy plans, team seats, rules and MCP migration) (verified 2026-10-20, switching costs 2026-10-22)
- [Gemini CLI vs Claude Code](https://codetoolpicker.com/gemini-cli-vs-claude-code/): since June 18, 2026 Gemini CLI no longer serves free, Google AI Pro or Ultra sign-ins (moved to closed-source Antigravity CLI); it stays open source (Apache 2.0) on paid Gemini API keys and Gemini Code Assist Standard (~$22.80/user/mo, $19 on 12 months) or Enterprise (~$54, $45); Claude Pro $20; teams of 5 ($95-$114 vs $100-$125); three-way note with Codex (verified 2026-10-22)
- [AI coding tool usage limits compared](https://codetoolpicker.com/usage-limits-compared/): Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and Antigravity side by side: published limits, reset windows (five-hour, weekly, monthly, daily), what happens at the limit, overage prices, and a clearly labeled estimated cost per task at API prices (verified 2026-10-23)
- [Advertise / sponsor packages](https://codetoolpicker.com/advertise/): founding sponsor packages ($150 and $300/mo), featured listing ($99/mo), newsletter sponsorship, and the editorial policy (rankings are never for sale)
- Ship your app: every comparison page and the pricing guide now list the usual next costs (hosting: Vercel, Netlify, Railway, Render; database: Supabase, Neon; code review: CodeRabbit; domains: Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun, Namecheap), with prices checked 2026-10-20
- [Full text for LLMs](https://codetoolpicker.com/llms-full.txt): tool-by-tool summaries
- [Tool data (JS)](https://codetoolpicker.com/data.js): structured pricing, annual prices, plan guides, and change log (window.TOOL_DATA, window.PRICING, window.PRICE_LOG)

## Quick answers
- Codex usage limits (verified 2026-11-13): Codex is included in ChatGPT Free and Go (GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app, no Codex Cloud), Plus $20 (5-hour window plus weekly limit; OpenAI estimates 15-160 local GPT-6.1 Sol, 35-285 GPT-6.1 Terra, 350-3,000 GPT-6 Luna, 5-45 GPT-6 Astra messages per 5 hours), Business Standard (same as Plus), Pro 100/200/500 (no 5-hour limit, weekly allowance; Tibo Sottiaux posted Nov 8, 2026 that they are 10x, 20x and 50x Plus, not stated on OpenAI help pages) and Business Premium (no 5-hour limit). The 5-hour window starts with the first message after the previous window ends. Codex did not become unlimited on Nov 12, 2026; a banked reset was activated that day (Tibo, Nov 12 21:59 UTC). Banked resets are saved, redeemable once a covered allowance is below 80% remaining, restore covered allowances to 100%, restart the period and expire. Paid instant resets (eligible Plus and Pro personal accounts) apply immediately, cannot be saved, price shown at checkout. Fast mode uses included allowance at 2.5x, Ultrafast (Pro 500) 8x. Starting in December 2026 Plus, Pro and Business usage is shared across ChatGPT and Codex, measured in tokens, Instant chat excluded; OpenAI has not published an exact date (Dec 1 unconfirmed). Dots: Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare free preview ends and billing starts Nov 18, 2026; Pro and Business Premium extended dot limits continue "for now" (no end date published). Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/codex-usage-limits/
- Claude Code secrets in settings.local.json (verified 2026-11-12): Choosing "Yes, and don't ask again" on a Bash prompt saves an allow rule in .claude/settings.local.json at the repo root; when the rule is the exact command, any password or token in it is saved in plain text. Claude Code adds **/.claude/settings.local.json to the global git excludes file the first time it writes it, never to the repo .gitignore. Apiiro (Nov 5, updated Nov 8) found 104,185 public copies, 1,122 with secrets (1,379 distinct, 63 orgs), 2,539 secrets in 1,994 repos counting history; 215 files missed by both gitleaks and TruffleHog. Anthropic said it is looking into secret scanning; no changelog fix as of Nov 12, 2026. Fix: rotate credentials, git rm --cached, add to .gitignore, use env vars in commands. Checker: https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-secrets-check/
- Claude Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5 (verified 2026-11-11): Anthropic released Fable 5.2 on Nov 9, 2026 (same model as Mythos 5.2, with cyber/bio safeguards). API price $8 input, $40 output, $0.20 cache reads, $10 5-minute cache writes per million tokens (Fable 5.1 was $10/$50); Opus 5.5 is $4/$20 with $0.20 cache reads; fast mode $16/$80 on Fable, $8/$40 on Opus 5.5. Plans: Pro ($20) and Team standard get Fable included until Nov 16, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT for up to 50% of weekly limits plus one Fable reset (paid before Nov 9), after which Fable runs on usage credits; Max ($100), Ultra ($200) and Team premium include Fable up to 50% of weekly limits and get 1 to 3 resets (by subscription length) expiring Mar 8, 2027. Claude Code needs 2.1.321+; /model fable; best alias now equals opus; -p runs bill usage credits without asking; switching models mid-session re-reads the whole conversation without cache. Anthropic recommends Opus 5.5 as the daily driver and Fable for open-ended, long-running work; its claim that Fable at High matched Opus at Max for about half the cost per task is self-reported. GitHub Copilot: Pro+, Max, Business, Enterprise at provider list price (admin policy off by default on Business/Enterprise). Cursor: $8/$40 on top of plan, data-retention opt-in under Privacy Mode. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-fable-5-2-vs-opus-5-5/
- JetBrains Air subscriptions (verified 2026-11-10): On Nov 3, 2026 GitHub and JetBrains made GitHub Copilot a built-in agent in JetBrains Air. Local tasks in a JetBrains IDE need Air plus a Copilot subscription (any plan GitHub accepts for the Copilot CLI) and bill to the Copilot plan, not JetBrains AI credits. Cloud tasks run in a sandboxed VM via Air Teams (JetBrains business customers only, admin must enable Copilot) and also bill to Copilot. Air cannot show or cap Copilot usage; tasks fail when credits run out. Codex in Air accepts ChatGPT Plus, Pro or team plans. Claude subscriptions work only by running Claude Code in Air's terminal surface; the Claude Agent chat needs JetBrains AI or an Anthropic API key. Cursor via the ACP registry needs a paid Cursor plan. JetBrains AI Pro $10 = 10 credits ($1 each), Ultimate $30 = 35 credits; Copilot Pro $10 = 1,500 credits ($0.01 each, about $15); Pro+ $39 = 7,000 credits. Air Business plan $20 per AI seat/mo for governance, credits extra. Junie Lite free for a limited time. Verdict: Copilot Pro $10 is the cheapest paid way to run an agent in Air; bring ChatGPT or Claude plans you already pay for; JetBrains AI only for Junie, cloud runs or one JetBrains bill. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/jetbrains-air-subscriptions/
- Cursor Live Apps vs Lovable vs Bolt (verified 2026-11-09): Cursor shipped Live Apps on Nov 5, 2026. A cloud agent scaffolds the app (new Cursor Origin repo or existing GitHub repo; GitLab coming soon), provisions Postgres if needed, puts private and team apps behind Cursor sign-in, hosts it in a dedicated account, and publishes to a URL you pick after always-on checks (secrets in files, credential files, no .env, no source maps) plus an AI security review. Needs a plan with cloud agents: Premium $30+, Teams, Enterprise or legacy paid; not Free or Plus $8. Cloud agent work bills at the model's rate from plan usage; third-party models at API list price. Cursor has not published hosting or database limits or prices, and docs don't mention custom domains. Lovable Pro $25 ($250/yr, 100 credits + 5/day, custom domains), Business $50 flat with unlimited members; Bolt Pro $25 ($18/mo annual, from 10M tokens, custom domain, up to 1M web requests), Teams $30/member. Verdict: use Live Apps for internal tools if you already pay for Cursor Premium+; use Lovable or Bolt for customer-facing apps on your own domain. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-live-apps-vs-lovable-bolt/
- SWE-2 Flash vs SWE-2 (verified 2026-11-06): Cognition launched SWE-2 Flash on Nov 4, 2026 for Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, not Devin Cloud. Docs say it is free until Dec 4, 2026 18:00 UTC, then $0.10/M input, $0.01/M cache reads, $0.125/M cache writes, $0.50/M output for Medium, High, and Max. Medium is on the Free plan; High and Max need a paid plan. SWE-2 is free on self-serve Desktop/CLI through Nov 30, 2026 (not cloud), then $3.00/M input, $15.00/M output, $0.30/M cache input. Our medium-task estimate (1.5M input, 90% cached, 25K output, cache writes left out) is about $0.04 for Flash vs about $1.23 for SWE-2 after those windows. The blog's 3x speed is a simulated replay at 200 vs 60 tok/s. The blog's one-fifth price claim matches the enterprise SWE-2 promo better than self-serve list rates, which are one-thirtieth. Weights are not public; Cognition is building a partner access program. Devin plan prices re-checked Nov 6, unchanged (Free $0, Pro $20, Max $200, Teams $80 + $40/seat). Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/swe-2-flash-vs-swe-2/
- GPT in Cursor after Nov 12 (verified 2026-11-05): OpenAI proposed Nov 12, 2026 as the end of its contract supplying models to Cursor (no future models such as Astra; date not confirmed; Cursor may end access sooner). Cursor's newest OpenAI models are GPT-5.6 Sol ($4/$20 per 1M, promo), Terra and Luna; no GPT-6. Your own OpenAI key or a gateway (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock) works only in local Chat and Agent, not Tab, Auto, Cloud Agents, Automations, CLI, API or SDK; own keys need Premium $30+ or a legacy plan, and Cursor says OpenAI keys support standard, non-reasoning chat models. The Codex IDE extension runs inside Cursor on a ChatGPT plan (Plus $20: GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra) or an API key. Medium task estimate: GPT-5.6 Sol in Cursor about $1.64 vs GPT-6.1 Sol at API price about $0.69. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/cursor-openai-cutoff/
- Claude Max vs Ultra (verified 2026-11-04): Max $100 = 5x Pro every five hours and every week, $100/mo API credits; Ultra $200 = 10x Pro per week, no five-hour limit for verified accounts (automatic verification; temporary limit until then), $200/mo API credits; both monthly only, Fable up to half the weekly limit. The Max/Ultra API credits cover the Claude API, Batches, Playground, Managed Agents and Agent SDK, not interactive Claude Code or usage credits, and expire each billing cycle. Doubling from about $100 to $200 by vendor multipliers: Google AI Ultra 5x to 20x Pro (4x), Cursor Super 15x to Ultra 50x Plus (3.3x), Claude 2x weekly, Kiro Pro Max 5,000 to Power 10,000 credits (2x, $0.02/credit on every plan), Copilot has no $200 plan (Max $100 = $200 AI credits incl. a $100 flex allotment that may change), ChatGPT Pro 100 vs 200 unpublished (no five-hour Codex limit on Pro currently), Devin Max $200 unpublished. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-max-vs-ultra/
- Jules alternatives (verified 2026-11-03): Google Jules can finish sessions until Nov 11, 2026, is read-only after, and winds down Dec 31 (jules.google changelog). Jules had 15/100/300 tasks per day on free/Google AI Pro/Ultra. Antigravity, Google's suggested destination, has no Google-hosted cloud sandbox yet (agents run on your machine or your own VM via Remote Control) and uses the shared plan quota. Cheapest hosted background agent: GitHub Copilot Pro $10 (Copilot in the cloud, paid plans only); Codex cloud on ChatGPT Plus $20; Claude Code cloud sessions on Claude Pro $20; Cursor Cloud Agents need Premium $30+; Devin Cloud on Devin Pro $20.
- ChatGPT Pro Codex limits (verified 2026-10-30 on help.openai.com): the Pro 200 reduction announced Sep 29 is canceled; higher-allowance accounts keep it, lower ones doubled to match, price $200. Pro 100 and Pro 500 get 2x their previous Work and Codex allowance; Plus unchanged; Business Premium increasing (no figure). OpenAI publishes no multiples (20x/10x/25x/50x are reported only). Monthly API credits since Oct 28: Pro $100/$200/$500; Business $20 per Standard seat, $100 per Premium seat, max $500 per workspace; not on Plus; they don't add ChatGPT or signed-in Codex usage. Details: https://codetoolpicker.com/chatgpt-pro-codex-limits/
- Cost per AI coding task (verified 2026-10-29): on Artificial Analysis's Coding Agent Index v2.0 (290 hard tasks, API prices incl. cache writes), Claude Code + Opus 5.5 (max) $11.42/task, Claude Code + Sonnet 5.5 $13.30, Antigravity CLI + Gemini 4 Argon (high) $11.73, Codex + GPT-6 Astra $7.04, Codex + GPT-6.1 Sol $1.50, Codex + GPT-6 Luna $0.16. Everyday medium task by our estimate: about $0.69 on Sonnet 5.5, $1.37 on Opus 5.5. In Antigravity, Google AI Pro has a separate weekly-only Gemini 4 Argon quota.
- Claude Code alternatives (verified 2026-10-28): GitHub Copilot Pro ($10/mo, 1,500 AI credits) includes Claude Sonnet 5.5 but not Opus 5.5 (Pro+ $39 and Copilot Business $19/seat include Opus 5.5); Google AI Pro ($19.99, non-trial) includes Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 in Antigravity; Kiro Pro ($20, 1,000 credits) lists Opus 5.5 at 2.0x and Sonnet 5.5 at 1.3x credits; OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus $20) has no Claude; Cursor bills Claude at API list price on Premium $30+; OpenCode Go ($10) includes only Claude Haiku 5.5; Zed Pro ($10) bills API price +10%, Augment adds a 40% service fee, Warp and Amp bill at API rates; Amp Claude Code mode and Zed Claude Agent use your Claude plan, so Claude limits still apply. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/claude-code-alternatives/
- Free AI coding tools (verified 2026-10-27): GitHub Copilot Free has 2,000 completions/mo with auto model selection only; Google Antigravity Free has unlimited Tab and a weekly agent quota, and Google removes Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-OSS-120b from Antigravity on Nov 18, 2026 (Free then has Gemini 3.8 Flash); Codex Free runs GPT-6 Luna in the ChatGPT desktop app (subject to rollout); Kiro Free includes Claude Sonnet 4.5 on 50 credits, rate limited; Bolt Free 1M tokens/mo; Lovable Free 5 credits/day; Claude Code has no free tier. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/free-ai-coding-tools/
- OpenAI Codex vs Cursor: Codex on ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) includes GPT-6.1 Sol; Cursor Plus ($8/mo, $80/yr) runs Grok and Composer only; OpenAI models in Cursor need Premium ($30) and are billed at API list price, and Cursor lists no GPT-6 models as of 2026-10-26. OpenAI supports the Codex IDE extension in Cursor, so Cursor Plus + ChatGPT Plus = $28/mo. Team of 5: ChatGPT Business $125/mo ($100 annual) vs Cursor Teams $150/mo + usage and a $0.25/M Cursor Token Rate. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/codex-vs-cursor/
- AI coding usage limits: Claude Code, Codex Plus and Antigravity (Google AI Pro) use five-hour windows plus weekly caps; Cursor uses one weekly pool; GitHub Copilot uses monthly AI credits ($0.01 each, reset 00:00 UTC on the 1st); Gemini CLI on Code Assist has 1,500 or 2,000 requests per user per day. Only GitHub (credits) and OpenAI (message ranges) publish allowance sizes. Estimated medium agent task (1.5M input tokens, 90% cached, 25K output) at API prices: about $0.69 on Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol or Gemini 4 Argon (before Dec 1, 2026), $1.37 on Opus 5.5, $1.13 on Grok 4.7. Source: https://codetoolpicker.com/usage-limits-compared/
- Gemini CLI vs Claude Code: Gemini CLI has no subscription option for individuals since June 18, 2026 (Google AI Pro/Ultra now cover Antigravity CLI instead); it runs on paid Gemini API keys or Code Assist licenses. Claude Code needs Claude Pro $20/mo ($17 billed annually). Gemini CLI is open source (Apache 2.0); Claude Code and Antigravity CLI are not (verified 2026-10-22)
- Cursor pricing fact-check: Plus is $8/mo but Grok-only; Claude and other third-party models need Premium $30+ and are billed at API list price from prepaid credit; Teams/Enterprise add a $0.25 per million token Cursor Token Rate on most third-party models (verified 2026-10-22 on cursor.com)
- GitHub Copilot vs Claude Code: Copilot Pro is $10/mo with 1,500 AI credits that reset monthly and include Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Claude Opus 5.5 starts at Pro+ $39); Claude Code needs Claude Pro at $20/mo with five-hour limits; Copilot Business $19/seat vs Claude Team $20-$25/seat (verified 2026-10-21)
- Best all-round AI IDE: Cursor (Plus $8/mo is Grok-only; Claude/GPT in Cursor cost extra at API list price on Premium $30+)
- Best for Claude-model users: Claude Code (Pro $20/mo)
- Best terminal/agentic coding: Claude Code
- Claude plans (re-checked 2026-11-02 on claude.com/pricing): Pro $20 ($17/mo billed annually), Max $100 (5x Pro usage every five hours and every week, $100/mo API credits), Ultra $200 (10x Pro usage per week, no five-hour limit for verified accounts, $200/mo API credits). On Oct 30, 2026 Anthropic renamed Max 5x to Max and Max 20x to Ultra at the same prices. Claude Code is included on all paid plans.
- Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex: same list prices (Pro/Plus $20, Max/Pro from $100, team seats $20 annual / $25 monthly); Codex has Free and Go ($8) tiers and no five-hour cap on ChatGPT Pro; Claude Max ($100) includes $100/mo API credits and Claude Ultra ($200) $200/mo (verified 2026-10-20; Claude plans re-checked 2026-11-02)
- Claude Code vs Codex reliability (official status pages, Sep 21 to Oct 20, 2026): Claude Code 4 incidents, 4.3 hours, all labeled major; Codex 7 incidents, 49.4 hours, mostly degraded performance (25 h from one ChatGPT desktop Work Mode incident), one 55-minute full outage
- Cursor vs Google Antigravity: Antigravity has a free tier and Google AI Pro ($19.99/mo) includes Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 in its quota; Ultra $99.99 (5x) or $199.99 (20x). Cursor Plus $8 is Grok-only and Claude/Gemini cost API list price on Premium $30+. Antigravity teams buy via Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise from $30/seat) (verified 2026-10-20)
- Cheapest way into a coding agent: OpenAI Codex Free or Go $8/mo (ChatGPT desktop app, subject to rollout)
- Cheapest multi-model in your existing editor: GitHub Copilot (Pro from $10/mo)
- Best Cursor-class IDE for managing many agents: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf; Pro $20/mo)
- Best for non-coders building full apps: Lovable or Bolt.new (both Pro $25/mo; Bolt $18/mo billed annually, Lovable $21/mo)
- Cheapest paid plans: Cursor Plus $8/mo (Grok only) and Codex Go $8/mo (desktop app only). Cheapest with Claude + GPT included: GitHub Copilot Pro $10/mo
- Best free options: GitHub Copilot Free (2,000 completions/mo), Google Antigravity Free (unlimited Tab, weekly agent quota), and Devin Desktop Free (unlimited Tab, light agent quota). Claude Code has no free tier
- Cheapest for a team of 5 (monthly billing): Lovable Business $50/mo total (unlimited users); Copilot Business $95; Claude Team $125; ChatGPT Business (Codex) $125; Antigravity via Gemini Enterprise from $150; Cursor Teams $150; Bolt Teams $150; Devin Desktop Teams $200
